name: LogicVista
description: LogicVista is a benchmark designed to evaluate the integrated logical reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in visual contexts. It covers 5 logical reasoning tasks with 9 different capabilities, using 448 multiple-choice questions annotated with correct answers and human-written reasoning.
reputation: A recent multimodal reasoning benchmark that is gaining attention for testing integrated logical reasoning in visual contexts, but it is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Includes human-written reasoning annotations enabling both multiple-choice and open-ended evaluation.
